name: layered-justifiable-supervision
description: Finite deterministic transition policy replacing the paper's restricted Prolog next_step core when a Prolog interpreter is unavailable.

rules.when: escalation reaches L1 and cannot be reformulated, or authority matter, or round budget exhausted

invariants: rework preserves what, why, evidence and escalate_if
reformulation is owned by the layer that issued the requirement
all continuation-capable transitions consume one shared episode budget
budget exhaustion never blocks escalation to the human authority
failed attempts remain explicit records and are never omitted from the dossier
context_digest binds each agent result to its rendered context packet
